# objectives
* read in clean ncbi and gisaid
* Compare and print lengths in each
* Harmonize column names in meta
* Merge together for each segment
* Any obvious identical?
* Export merged data

## change log 
### 2025-04-02
* fixed issue with isolate_name not carrying forward (to match on sample)

### 2025-03-27
* fixed issues with file naming for proteins
* need to re-run prot alignments, but nucleotide fine
* updated some file naming, folder strctr

# Setup
## libs
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T)
```

```{r libs, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)
library(gtools)
```

## Ins and Outs
```{r}
#ncbi, most recent clean_out
ncbi.f<-"../01a_ncbi/clean_ncbi/ncbi_out_2025-12-12/"
gis.f<-"../01b_gisaid/clean_gisaid/gisaid_out_2026-01-08/"

#within them
ncbi.meta.in<-list.files(ncbi.f,pattern = "ncbi_meta*",full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()
ncbi.nuc.in<-list.files(ncbi.f,pattern = "ncbi_nuc*",full.names = T)  %>% mixedsort()
#multimatch
ncbi.prot.in0<-list.files(ncbi.f,pattern = "ncbi_protein*",full.names = T)  %>% mixedsort()
ncbi.prot.in<-str_subset(ncbi.prot.in0, "meta", negate = T) %>% mixedsort()
ncbi.prot.meta.in<-str_subset(ncbi.prot.in0, "meta") %>% mixedsort()

#gisaid
gis.meta.in<-list.files(gis.f,pattern = "gisaid_meta*",full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()
gis.nuc.in<-list.files(gis.f,pattern = "gisaid_nuc*",full.names = T)  %>% mixedsort()
#multimatch
gis.prot.in0<-list.files(gis.f,pattern = "gisaid_protein*",full.names = T)  %>% mixedsort()
gis.prot.in<-str_subset(gis.prot.in0, "meta", negate = T) %>% mixedsort()
gis.prot.meta.in<-str_subset(gis.prot.in0, "meta") %>% mixedsort()

#outputs
today<-Sys.Date()
f.out<-paste0(today, "_merged/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}
f.out.meta<-paste0(f.out, "merged_meta/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out.meta)){dir.create(f.out.meta)}
f.out.fasta<-paste0(f.out, "merged_fasta/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out.fasta)){dir.create(f.out.fasta)}

#output for each segment (alphabetical)
segments<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS") %>% mixedsort()
prot.ord<-c("PB2","PB1","PB1-F2","PA-X","PA","HA",
            "NP","NA", "M1","M2", "NEP","NS1") %>% mixedsort()

nuc.meta.out<-str_replace_all(gis.meta.in, gis.f, f.out.meta) %>% 
  str_replace_all("gisaid","merged")

nuc.out<-str_replace_all(gis.nuc.in, gis.f, f.out.fasta) %>% 
  str_replace_all("gisaid","merged")

prot.meta.out<-str_replace_all(gis.prot.meta.in, gis.f, f.out.meta) %>% 
  str_replace_all("gisaid","merged")

prot.out<-str_replace_all(gis.prot.in, gis.f, f.out.fasta) %>% 
  str_replace_all("gisaid","merged")

#Write a log text file
text.out<-paste0(f.out,today,"_logfile.txt")
cat(paste0("Run date: ",today),file=text.out,sep="\n",append = F)
```

## read in clean ncbi and gisaid meta, nuc, protein
```{r}
#set up empty lists for nuc and meta to read an element for each segment
l.seg<-length(segments)

message("Reading nucleotide data")
ncbi.meta<-purrr::map(ncbi.meta.in,read.csv)
ncbi.nuc<-purrr::map(ncbi.nuc.in,Biostrings::readDNAStringSet)
gis.meta<-purrr::map(gis.meta.in,read.csv)
gis.nuc<-purrr::map(gis.nuc.in,Biostrings::readDNAStringSet)

#Separately iterate over prot (diff length)
l.prot<-length(prot.ord)

message("Reading protein data")
ncbi.prot<-purrr::map(ncbi.prot.in,Biostrings::readAAStringSet)
ncbi.prot.meta<-purrr::map(ncbi.prot.meta.in,read.csv)
gis.prot<-purrr::map(gis.prot.in,Biostrings::readAAStringSet)
gis.prot.meta<-purrr::map(gis.prot.meta.in,read.csv)

#check
names(ncbi.nuc[[1]]) %>% head
# ncbi.prot[[1]] %>% head
# length(ncbi.prot[[1]])
# names(ncbi.prot[[1]])[1:5]
```

## Harmonize column names in meta
```{r}
i=1
# head(ncbi.meta[[i]])
# head(gis.meta[[i]])
for(i in 1:l.seg){
  #change meta colnames to lowercase
  colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]])<-tolower(colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]]))
  colnames(gis.meta[[i]])<-tolower(colnames(gis.meta[[i]]))
}

#Main columns to carry forward
#explore which cols don't have match in other dataset: pick as needed
ncbi.nomatch.col<-which(!colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]]) %in% colnames(gis.meta[[i]]))
colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]])[ncbi.nomatch.col]
gis.nomatch.col<-which(!colnames(gis.meta[[i]]) %in% colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]]))
colnames(gis.meta[[i]])[gis.nomatch.col]

#change to common set of colnames
for(i in 1:l.seg){
  #these are common to the sample and can be used to lookup sample 
  gis.meta[[i]]$sample<-gis.meta[[i]]$isolate_id
  
  colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]])<-str_replace_all(colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]]),
    c("geo_location"="location",
      "geo_location_sml"="city"))
  ncbi.meta[[i]]$date_parse<-as.character(ncbi.meta[[i]]$date_parse)
}

main.cols<-colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]])[which(colnames(ncbi.meta[[i]]) %in% colnames(gis.meta[[i]]))]
main.cols

#also want to carry forward select additional (that will only be complete for either)
# which(main.col2 %in% colnames(gis.meta[[i]]))
gis.cols<-unique(c(main.cols, c( "genotype", "lineage", "clade", "state",
                                 "isolate_id","isolate_name","segment_id") ))

ncbi.cols<-unique(c(main.cols, c( "genbank_title","accession") ))

#Check each meta matches its nuc names
all(ncbi.meta[[i]]$seq_new%in% names(ncbi.nuc[[i]]))
all(gis.meta[[i]]$seq_new%in% names(gis.nuc[[i]]))
```

## Merge zem
```{r}
#for each segment, 
merged.nuc<-merged.meta<-replicate(n=l.seg, vector())
#bind_rows for meta and nucleotide sequences
text.temp<-NA
for(i in 1:l.seg){
  myseg<-segments[i]
  merged.meta[[i]]<-bind_rows(ncbi.meta[[i]][,ncbi.cols], gis.meta[[i]][,gis.cols])
  merged.nuc[[i]]<-c(ncbi.nuc[[i]], gis.nuc[[i]])   

  #text output of n seq by segment
  text.temp<-paste0(text.temp, 
                    "\n N sequences ", segments[i],": ", nrow(merged.meta[[i]])) 
}
cat(text.temp, file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Repeat for proteins
```{r}
merged.prot.meta<-merged.prot<-replicate(n=l.prot, vector()) 

#bind_rows for meta (common columns only)
#c() for fasta
text.temp<-NA
for(i in 1:l.prot){
  myprot<-prot.ord[i]
  merged.prot[[i]]<-c(ncbi.prot[[i]], gis.prot[[i]])
  
  #use gisaid isolate_id as the sample identifier
  gis.prot.meta[[i]]$sample<-gis.prot.meta[[i]]$isolate_id
  
  #remove unnec col
  ncbi.prot.meta[[i]]<-ncbi.prot.meta[[i]][,-which(colnames(ncbi.prot.meta[[i]]) %in% c("C"))]
  merged.prot.meta[[i]]<-bind_rows(ncbi.prot.meta[[i]], gis.prot.meta[[i]])
  
  #text output of n seq by segment
  text.temp<-paste0(text.temp, 
                    "\n N merged a.a. sequences ", prot.ord[i],": ", nrow(merged.prot.meta[[i]])) 
}

cat(text.temp, file=text.out,sep="\n",append = T)
```

## Export merged data
```{r}
purrr::iwalk(seq_len(l.seg),function(i,.){
  write.csv(merged.meta[[i]],nuc.meta.out[i])
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(merged.nuc[[i]],nuc.out[i])
})

purrr::iwalk(seq_len(l.prot),function(i,.){
  write.csv(merged.prot.meta[[i]],prot.meta.out[i])
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(merged.prot[[i]],prot.out[i])
})
```
